text: The food was delicious and the vendors served everyone quickly
The live band delivered an outstanding performance and the crowd loved every moment
The security officers were polite and made us feel safe throughout the event
The venue was clean, comfortable and well organised
The food queues were extremely long and many visitors waited over an hour
The tickets were ridiculously expensive for the experience provided
The staff were rude and refused to help when I asked for directions
There was nowhere to park and visitors had to leave their cars far away
The speakers kept producing distorted sounds and the music was difficult to enjoy
The security checks were poorly managed and people pushed through the entrance
The festival started at the advertised time and followed the published schedule
There were several food vendors and different meal options available
